AssociateManagedApis.name: AssociateManagedApis
AssociateManagedApis.documentation: Associate one or more Managed APIs with a product. Best-effort — IDs that fail are returned in {@link AssociateManagedApisResponse#failedItems}; IDs that succeed are omitted. Associating an already-associated Managed API is a no-op (not reported as failure).

CreateManagedApi.name: CreateManagedApi
CreateManagedApi.documentation: Promote a discovered API in the API inventory into the managed API list.

CreatePortal.name: CreatePortal
CreatePortal.documentation: Creates a portal that publishes documentation for the products it includes. Use UpdatePortalPublishStatus to publish it.

CreatePortalPreview.name: CreatePortalPreview
CreatePortalPreview.documentation: Starts building a preview of the portal's current content. Use GetPortal to check the preview status and get the preview URL.

CreateProduct.name: CreateProduct
CreateProduct.documentation: Creates a product. A product groups Managed APIs with their API pages and product pages so a portal can publish them together.

CreateProductApiPage.name: CreateProductApiPage
CreateProductApiPage.documentation: Creates an API page that documents a Managed API in a product. The page content is generated asynchronously. Use status to track it.

CreateProductPage.name: CreateProductPage
CreateProductPage.documentation: Creates a product page with free-form documentation. A product can have up to 40 pages.

DeleteDiscoveryConfiguration.name: DeleteDiscoveryConfiguration
DeleteDiscoveryConfiguration.documentation: Deletes the discovery configuration and stops any running discovery.

DeleteOrganizationDiscoveryConfiguration.name: DeleteOrganizationDiscoveryConfiguration
DeleteOrganizationDiscoveryConfiguration.documentation: Deletes the organization-wide discovery configuration and stops any running discovery across the organization. Only the organization management account may call this operation.

DeleteProductSharingPolicy.name: DeleteProductSharingPolicy
DeleteProductSharingPolicy.documentation: Deletes the sharing policy of a product. The product is no longer shared.

DisassociateManagedApis.name: DisassociateManagedApis
DisassociateManagedApis.documentation: Disassociate one or more Managed APIs from a product. Best-effort — IDs that fail are returned in {@link DisassociateManagedApisResponse#failedItems}; IDs that succeed are omitted. Disassociating an unmapped Managed API is a no-op (not reported as failure).

GetApiInventoryItem.name: GetApiInventoryItem
GetApiInventoryItem.documentation: Gets full details of a single API inventory item.

GetDiscoveryConfiguration.name: GetDiscoveryConfiguration
GetDiscoveryConfiguration.documentation: Retrieves the discovery configuration for the account and region.

GetManagedApi.name: GetManagedApi
GetManagedApi.documentation: Returns a Managed API, including its security posture findings.

GetOrganizationDiscoveryConfiguration.name: GetOrganizationDiscoveryConfiguration
GetOrganizationDiscoveryConfiguration.documentation: Retrieves the organization-wide discovery configuration. Only the organization management account and registered delegated administrators may call this operation.

GetPortal.name: GetPortal
GetPortal.documentation: Returns the configuration, publish status, and preview status of a portal.

GetProduct.name: GetProduct
GetProduct.documentation: Returns a product. To read a product shared with you by another account, supply resourceOwnerAccountId.

GetProductApiPage.name: GetProductApiPage
GetProductApiPage.documentation: Returns an API page, including its body.

GetProductPage.name: GetProductPage
GetProductPage.documentation: Returns a product page, including its body.

GetProductSharingPolicy.name: GetProductSharingPolicy
GetProductSharingPolicy.documentation: Returns the sharing policy of a product.

ListApiInventoryItems.name: ListApiInventoryItems
ListApiInventoryItems.documentation: Lists discovered API inventory items with filtering and pagination.

ListManagedApiEvents.name: ListManagedApiEvents
ListManagedApiEvents.documentation: Lists API-security events for a single managed API, most recent first. Returns up to 20 of the most recent events (not paginated).

ListManagedApis.name: ListManagedApis
ListManagedApis.documentation: Lists the Managed APIs in your account.

ListProductApiPages.name: ListProductApiPages
ListProductApiPages.documentation: Lists the API pages in a product. The results do not include page bodies.

ListProductPages.name: ListProductPages
ListProductPages.documentation: Lists the product pages in a product. The results do not include page bodies.

ListProducts.name: ListProducts
ListProducts.documentation: Lists products you own, products shared with you, or both.

ListTagsForResource.name: ListTagsForResource
ListTagsForResource.documentation: Lists the tags for an API Portal resource. One of the three basic tagging operations generated for Tagris integration (ListTagsForResource / TagResource / UntagResource).

PutOrganizationDiscoveryConfiguration.name: PutOrganizationDiscoveryConfiguration
PutOrganizationDiscoveryConfiguration.documentation: Creates or updates the organization-wide discovery configuration. This is a singleton per organization. Only the organization management account and registered delegated administrators may call this operation.

PutProductSharingPolicy.name: PutProductSharingPolicy
PutProductSharingPolicy.documentation: Creates or replaces the sharing policy of a product. The policy controls which other accounts can read the product.

TagResource.name: TagResource
TagResource.documentation: Adds or updates tags on an API Portal resource. One of the three basic tagging operations generated for Tagris integration (ListTagsForResource / TagResource / UntagResource).

UntagResource.name: UntagResource
UntagResource.documentation:
Removes tags from an API Portal resource. One of the three basic tagging operations generated for Tagris integration (ListTagsForResource / TagResource / UntagResource).

tagKeys is a query string parameter: for tag-based access control (TBAC/ABAC) to work correctly, API Gateway requires the keys to be removed to be passed as a query string parameter.

UpdatePortal.name: UpdatePortal
UpdatePortal.documentation: Updates a portal. Only the fields supplied in the request are changed.

UpdatePortalPublishStatus.name: UpdatePortalPublishStatus
UpdatePortalPublishStatus.documentation: Publishes or disables a portal. The change runs asynchronously. Use GetPortal to track publishStatus.

UpdateProduct.name: UpdateProduct
UpdateProduct.documentation: Updates a product. Only the fields supplied in the request are changed.

UpdateProductApiPage.name: UpdateProductApiPage
UpdateProductApiPage.documentation: Updates an API page. Only the fields supplied in the request are changed.

RULE_BASED - membership is derived from ruleFilters: every Managed API in the account that matches is associated, and nothing else is. BatchAssociateManagedApi and BatchDisassociateManagedApi are rejected for these products.

Fixed at create time. UpdateProduct cannot change the mode of an existing product.

Classification.documentation:
Whether any account has created a ManagedApi for a discovered API, and for a managed API whether it is unused or no longer in the caller's organization. SHADOW - no account has created a ManagedApi for this item. MANAGED - some account in the caller's organization has created a ManagedApi for this item. MANAGED_ZOMBIE - managed and unused: no traffic for at least the account's no-traffic window. The API is still reachable, so this clears once traffic resumes. MANAGED_ORPHANED - managed, but the account hosting the API has left the caller's organization or been closed. The item is a last-known snapshot: it is no longer rediscovered, and its findings are not authorized for the caller. An organizational unit move is not a trigger.

MANAGED_ZOMBIE and MANAGED_ORPHANED add detail to a MANAGED item, so neither is returned for an item the caller does not manage, and MANAGED_ORPHANED takes priority over MANAGED_ZOMBIE. Both are derived per request rather than stored, so neither expires on its own.

Host.documentation: A discovered API's front-door hostname (e.g. an ALB, CloudFront, or API Gateway DNS name), bounded by the DNS name limit (RFC 1035). When 10 or more hosts differ only in that part, they fold into one, e.g. a.example.com, b.example.com, ... become "<>.example.com". Deeper levels fold the same way ("<>.<>.example.com"). features.documentation: Optional capabilities to enable. Omitting it disables all of them, as with the other fields.

discoverySources.documentation: The sources to discover APIs from. Omitting it removes all sources, which stops discovery for this configuration.

exclusionFilters.documentation: Exclusion filters for organization-scoped discovery. @deprecated. Remove this once client (Console) moves to discoveryFilters

discoveryFilters.documentation: The accounts or organizational units to include in or exclude from discovery.

features.documentation: Optional capabilities to enable. Omitting it disables all of them, as with the other fields.

policyDocument.documentation: The sharing policy as a JSON resource policy document.

ResourceNotFoundException.documentation: The requested resource does not exist, or you do not have access to it.

values.documentation: The values to match. The filter matches when the attribute equals any of them.

RuleFilter.documentation: Values are compared to the attribute as literals: exact and case-sensitive, no wildcards.

RuleFilterKey.documentation: The Managed API attribute a RuleFilter compares against. RESOURCE_ARN - apiSignature.resourceArn HOST - apiSignature.hostname METHOD - apiSignature.method, so values must be HttpMethod names PATH - apiSignature.path PORT - apiSignature.port, compared as its decimal string, so values must be 0-65535 with no leading zeros ACCOUNT - the account hosting the API, which for an ORGANIZATION-scoped Managed API is the member account rather than the account that created it

RuleFilterList.documentation: One filter per RuleFilterKey: filters are AND-ed, so two on the same key never both match.

RuleFilterValue.documentation:
Bounded by the longest matchable attribute, apiSignature.path.

No whitespace: none of the matchable attributes (ARN, hostname, method, path, port, account) contain any. Per-key formats (METHOD, PORT, ACCOUNT) are enforced in ProductValidator.validateRuleFilterValue, since one pattern cannot express them for a value shared by every key.

sectionName.documentation: Shown in the portal navigation. Same bound as page titles and operation names, and no control characters (the service rejects a blank name).

Section.documentation: A named group of API pages in the portal navigation.

id.documentation: Identifier of the discovery configuration to start. Required. Today this is the configuration ARN, which carries the owner account id so a delegated admin or org admin can start an org-scoped configuration that lives in a different account.

Identifier of the discovery configuration to stop. Required. Today this is the configuration ARN, which carries the owner account id so a delegated admin or org admin can stop an org-scoped configuration that lives in a different account.

TagKey.documentation: A tag key of 1-128 Unicode characters, per the AWS tagging limits.

TagValue.documentation: A tag value of 0-256 Unicode characters, per the AWS tagging limits; an empty value is valid.

Tags.documentation: Up to 50 tags per request, matching API Gateway's limit of 50 tags per resource.

ThreatCategory.documentation: OWASP API Security category, e.g. "API2:2023". Open string — OWASP revises the list per edition.

ThreatLabel.documentation: Detection label describing the attack and its confidence tier, e.g. "awswaf:managed:aws:api-security:credential-stuffing-high".

tagKeys.documentation: The keys of the tags to remove, up to 50.

description.documentation: A description of this publish request, up to 1024 characters.

portalContent.documentation: The new display name, description, and theme. Omit it to keep the current values.

authorization.documentation: The new authorization settings. Omit it to keep the current settings.

rumAppMonitorName.documentation: The new CloudWatch RUM app monitor name. Omit it to keep the current value.

includedProductArns.documentation: The new list of product ARNs, up to 200. It replaces the current list. Omit it to keep the current list.

logoUri.documentation: The new S3 location of the portal logo, in the form s3://bucket/key. An empty string removes the logo. Omit it to keep the current logo.

authorization.documentation: How readers sign in to the portal, and whether fine-grained access control is on.

portalContent.documentation: The portal's display name, description, and theme.

includedProductArns.documentation: The ARNs of the products the portal includes.

publishStatus.documentation: The publish status of the portal. Absent if the portal has never been published.

publishDescription.documentation: The description supplied with the most recent publish request.

rumAppMonitorName.documentation: The name of the CloudWatch RUM app monitor that collects reader telemetry for the portal.

preview.documentation: The most recent preview of the portal. Absent if no preview has been created.

tryItState.documentation: The new Try-It setting. Omit it to keep the current setting. To enable it, the page's API URL must use HTTPS on a domain that supports Try-It.
Whether Try-It is enabled on the page.

status.documentation: The status of the page content: IN_PROGRESS while it is generated, then AVAILABLE or FAILED.

displayContent.documentation: The new title and body of the page. Omit it to keep the current content.
The title and body of the page.

displayName.documentation: The new name of the product. Omit it to keep the current name.

description.documentation: The new description of the product. Omit it to keep the current description.

displayOrder.documentation: The new page order. Omit it to keep the current order.

apiSelectionConfiguration.documentation: The new API selection settings. The selection mode must match the mode the product was created with. Omit it to keep the current settings.

displayName.documentation: The name of the product, from 1 to 255 characters.

displayOrder.documentation: The order of the product's pages and API page sections in the portal navigation.

description.documentation: A description of the product, up to 1024 characters.

apiSelectionConfiguration.documentation: How Managed APIs are selected for the product.

Visibility.documentation: Whether a discovered API is reachable publicly or only from within a private network.

WafApiSecurityEventDetail.documentation: Detail specific to a WAF API-security event.

WafStatus.documentation: Whether a WAF web ACL is attached to the API's front-door service.

WebAclArn.documentation: ARN of the WebACL that produced the event. Carried on the event detail so GetManagedApiEvent can fetch the event's full detail; scope and region are derived from it.

Workload.documentation: An AI protocol seen in an API's traffic, detected by the front door from request or response headers (and, for A2A, a query parameter). MCP - Model Context Protocol. LLM - traffic to or from an LLM inference server or gateway. A2A - Agent2Agent protocol.

documentation: API Portal discovers the APIs running in your AWS accounts and organization, lets you manage them as Managed APIs, and publishes their documentation to developer portals.
